project_name.justification: The primary project is identified in the headline: "Quebec Rare Earth Elements Enters into Option Agreement to Acquire Lynx Ree Project in Quebec, Canada".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Quebec Rare Earth Elements Corp. (CSE: QREE) (formerly, Metallica Metals Corp.) (the "Company")".

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer is identified in both articles: "Benoit Desormeaux, President & Chief Executive Officer".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company has an option "to acquire a 100% beneficial and legal interest in the Lynx REE project located in Quebec, Canada (the "Property")."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is named the "Lynx REE project" and the acquiring company's focus is stated as "a mining exploration and development company focused on Rare Earth Elements (REE)".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled "Quebec Rare Earth Elements Enters into Option Agreement to Acquire Lynx Ree Project in Quebec, Canada", which directly pertains to the specified project and transaction.

currency.justification: The payments are denominated in '$' and the acquiring company, Quebec Rare Earth Elements Corp., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), implying the currency is Canadian Dollars.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of all required payments under the option agreement: a $10,000 payment on the Effective Date, a $20,000 payment on the first anniversary, a $40,000 payment on the second anniversary, a $60,000 payment on the third anniversary, and a milestone payment of $200,000 upon obtaining a PEA, pre-feasibility, or feasibility study. (10000+20000+40000+60000+200000=330000).

share_payments_raw.justification: No total raw dollar value for the share payments is provided in the text. The consideration is provided as a number of shares and a deemed price for only the initial tranche.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text provides separate cash and share components, not a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total shares to be issued is the sum of all tranches under the option agreement: "issue the Optionor 100,000 common shares", "issue the Optionor 100,000 Common Shares", "issue the Optionor 150,000 Common Shares", and "issue the Optionor 200,000 Common Shares". (100000+100000+150000+200000=550000).

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share warrant payments.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any option payments as part of the consideration; the agreement itself is an option agreement with consideration paid in cash and shares.

issued_share_price.justification: The first tranche of shares will be issued "at a deemed issue price of $0.155 per Common Share". This is the only share price specified for the transaction.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention any exploration commitment in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text does not mention any monetary exploration commitment as part of the option agreement.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The text does not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) being acquired or retained as part of the transaction.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The property subject to the option agreement "covers 2,034 Ha (20.3 sq. km)". A subsequent land acquisition via staking is mentioned but is a separate transaction.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states the property "covers 2,034 Ha (20.3 sq. km)".

resource_size.justification: The text explicitly states in a cautionary statement: "no known mineral resources/reserves".

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the text as "Quebec Rare Earth Elements Corp. (CSE: QREE)".
